performance.driver: Total operating income in the third quarter of 2026 increased 34% in absolute dollars and increased 500 basis points as a percent of revenue when compared to the year-ago quarter. The increase in operating income as a percent of revenue was primarily driven by gross margin improvements, as described above.

Operating income For the three and nine months ended September 26, 2026, operating income increased by $9.2 million and $22.7 million, respectively, due to the aggregated effect of the items described above.

Net sales increase was primarily due to higher volume of $138.3 million and $56.8 million in the electronics products and semiconductor businesses, respectively, driven by higher end market demand and favorable price.
